segments.zh: 叙述者想通过 Armand 这个人物说明什么？
segments.en: What does the narrator want to show through his portrait of Armand?

segments.zh: 我的邻居 Armand 是个节省时间的人。
segments.en: My neighbour Armand is a man who saves time.

segments.zh: 早上他省时间，因为有一台机器在他起床前就煮好咖啡；在办公室他省时间，因为有软件替他整理邮件；晚上他也省时间，一边洗碗一边用两倍速听书。
segments.en: He saves it in the morning, thanks to a machine that makes his coffee before he gets up; he saves it at the office, where software sorts his emails for him; he saves it in the evening, listening to books at double speed while he does the dishes.

segments.zh: 有一天，他带着真诚的自豪给我算过：这样他每天能省下将近三个小时。
segments.en: One day, with sincere pride, he worked out for me that he saved nearly three hours a day this way.

segments.zh: 我等了很久，想看看他会用这些时间做什么。
segments.en: For a long time I waited to see what he would do with all those hours.

segments.zh: 我想象他终于会去学大提琴，或者会坐到花园里的长椅上，就是那张他刷过两遍漆、却从没有人见他坐过的长椅。
segments.en: I imagined he would finally learn the cello, or sit on the bench in his garden, the one he has painted twice and where no one has ever seen him sit.

segments.zh: 可是省下来的时间有个奇怪的习惯：一存起来就不见了，就像放进破口袋里的硬币。
segments.en: But saved hours have a curious habit of vanishing as soon as you put them aside, like coins slipped into a pocket with a hole in it.

segments.zh: 就在昨天，Armand 手里拿着手机，隔着树篱跟我打了个招呼，脚步没停。
segments.en: Just yesterday, Armand waved to me over the hedge without stopping, his phone in his hand.

segments.zh: 他跟我解释说，他一分钟也没有：他得去买一台机器，好让自己终于能睡得快一点。
segments.en: He didn't have a minute, he explained: he had to go and buy a device that would finally let him sleep faster.

segments.zh: 我祝他好运，却不敢问他把省下的那么多时间放到哪里去了。
segments.en: I wished him luck, without daring to ask him where he kept all that time.

segments.zh: 他大概是我认识的最富有的人，也是最贫穷的人。
segments.en: He is probably the richest man I know, and the poorest too.

options.zh: Armand 一心想省时间，结果从来没有享受过时间。
options.en: By trying so hard to save time, Armand never gets to enjoy it.

options.zh: Armand 为每天省下的三个小时感到自豪是对的。
options.en: Armand is right to be proud of the three hours he saves.

options.zh: Armand 靠自己的安排发了财。
options.en: Armand has become rich thanks to his organisation.

options.zh: 叙述者也想睡得快一点。
options.en: The narrator would also like to sleep faster.

analysis.summary: 问叙述者通过 Armand 想表达什么。全文是反讽：Armand 不停地省时间，却从来没有时间，连睡觉都想“更快”。

A.why: 原文说省下的时间“disparaître dès qu'on les met de côté”（一存起来就不见了）。Armand 也“n'avait pas une minute”（一分钟也没有），从没坐过自己的长椅。他省下时间，却从不享受。

B.why: “avec une fierté sincère”（带着真诚的自豪）只是描写 Armand 自己的感受。叙述者用反讽说明这三个小时没有用处。陷阱：选项借用了 trois heures 和 fierté。

C.why: “le plus riche”（最富有）是比喻：他省下的时间最多，却没有时间享受，所以也“le plus pauvre”（最贫穷）。原文没有说他赚了钱。陷阱：选项把比喻的 riche 当成了字面意思。

D.why: “dormir plus vite”（睡得更快）是 Armand 想买的机器。叙述者在讽刺这个想法，不是羡慕。陷阱：选项借用了 dormir plus vite。
